result.title: Interleukin-6 and autoimmunity: a review of the pathogenic role of IL-6 in rheumatoid arthritis.
result.abstractText: Interleukin-6 (IL-6) is a pleiotropic cytokine with a central role in rheumatoid arthritis. IL-6 activates JAK/STAT3 signalling and promotes Th17 differentiation.

result.title: A preprint on IL-6 blockade and fatigue in rheumatoid arthritis
result.abstractText: In this preprint we report that IL-6 blockade reduced fatigue scores in rheumatoid arthritis.
